metadata.title: Add support for the QUERY HTTP method

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include QUERY in the CORS wildcard method set**

When this endpoint is used cross-origin behind `CORSMiddleware(allow_methods=["*"])`, a browser must preflight the non-safelisted `QUERY` method, but `starlette/middleware/cors.py` still expands `"*"` to an `ALL_METHODS` tuple that omits `QUERY`; `preflight_response()` consequently returns `400 Disallowed CORS method`. Add `QUERY` to that wildcard set so the newly supported method works with the documented all-methods configuration.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid emitting QUERY operations in pre-3.2 schemas**

For an existing `SchemaGenerator` configured with OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1—as the repository's `docs/schemas.md` example still is—adding a `query()` handler now unconditionally emits a `query` Path Item field, although that operation is only defined by OpenAPI 3.2. The resulting document is invalid for its declared version, so discovery should either gate this method on the configured OpenAPI version or the supported configuration and documentation must be updated accordingly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
